summary: Paradev's README carries no quantitative claims; its evidence is internal desktop/host-service performance work. The best-supported item is the watcher-terminal benchmark (script plus all 12 raw runs in results.json, input-echo worst case 284.9 -> 16.9 ms); other bench harnesses exist with results only in plan docs, and the public changelog's figures (e.g. 82.3 -> 28.0 ms stalls, '12x faster' deletion) are not backed by committed data and partly disagree with the plan docs.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
